# paaduGajala

> A SvelteKit-based Carnatic music notation player and virtual piano for parsing, previewing, and playing Carnatic swaras with a standalone interactive keyboard.

Built with SvelteKit 2, Svelte 5 (runes mode), TypeScript, Vite, and the Web Audio API.

## Getting Started
- [README](README.md): Project overview, tech stack, local setup, and deployment notes
- [Quickstart: Lift-and-Shift Refactor](specs/003-lift-shift-refactor/quickstart.md): How the SvelteKit migration was structured and how to verify parity

## Routes
- [Main Player (`/`)](src/routes/+page.svelte): Notation input, parse, playback controls, settings, preview, and embedded piano
- [Piano (`/piano`)](src/routes/piano/+page.svelte): Standalone interactive piano with mouse, touch, and keyboard input
- [Sruti to Swara (`/sruti-to-swara`)](src/routes/sruti-to-swara/+page.svelte): Sruti-to-swara mapping utility
- [Theory (`/theory`)](src/routes/theory/+page.svelte): Music theory reference page

## Domain & Architecture
- [App Services](src/app/services/): Orchestration layer — main-player-page, piano-page, app-bootstrap, visualizer-state
- [App Stores](src/app/stores/): Reactive state — notation, playback, settings, ui stores
- [Domain Modules](src/domain/): Pure logic — audio, notation parsing/validation, piano, pitch, shared utilities
- [Components](src/components/): UI components grouped by: common, layout, notation, piano, playback

## Specs & Feature Plans
- [003 Lift-and-Shift Refactor](specs/003-lift-shift-refactor/spec.md): Full SvelteKit migration spec from legacy HTML/JS app
- [004 Design Language Overhaul](specs/004-design-language-store/spec.md): Complete UI redesign replacing the legacy `--pg-*` visual system
- [005 Piano Playback](specs/005-piano-playback/spec.md): Piano-integrated playback with note-follow highlighting
